Sheet.name: Name
Sheet.gradeHint: The Awakened's Threat Grade. Starts at 1 and rises every 3 advances.
Sheet.advancesHint: At the end of a plot, a great change or a solved mystery: +1 Guard, +1 Memory or +1 maximum Aura.

Aura.label: Aura
Aura.hint: Starting value: 3. Burn Aura to turn 1s into Hits and to pay for techniques and spells.

Attribute.title: Attributes / Reserves
Attribute.hint: Distribute 4, 3 and 2, or leave all at 3. Use the attribute (maximum) value for tests.

Integrity.title: Integrity
Integrity.barrierHint: Subtract Barrier from all damage before Guard, then reduce it by 1. PD damage ignores barriers.

Wounds.marked: {name} marks a {wound} and resets Guard to maximum.
Wounds.defeatCheck: Echo Die against defeat: defeated on a result ≤ {count}
Wounds.noneLeft: {name} has no wound boxes left: defeated or dead.

Essence.title: Essence and Appearance
Essence.dropHint: Drag an Essence from the compendium here.
Essence.auraRecovered: {name} acts true to their Essence and recovers 3 Aura.

Background.title: Background and Inventory
Background.hint: Generate a Weave Point to gain +{dice}d on a test related to your Background or Inventory.
Background.invoked: {name} draws on their Background/Inventory (+{dice}d) and generates 1 Weave.

Trait.title: Traits
Trait.dropHint: Drag Traits from the compendium here.

Style.title: Combat Style
Style.hint: Choose a property and name your style. If you carry a pact weapon, describe it.
Style.name: Style name / description
Style.idealRangeHint: While attacking at your ideal range, receive +1d.

Ability.title: Techniques and Spells
Ability.countHint: At creation, choose a number of abilities equal to your Memory.
Ability.investHint: Special-cost spells: how much Aura to invest.

Technique.title: Techniques
Technique.dropHint: Drag Techniques from the compendium here.

Spell.title: Spells
Spell.dropHint: Drag Spells from the compendium here.

Restriction.title: Restriction Pact
Restriction.hint: Major Restrictions give Major Benefits; Minor give Minor. Maximum restrictions = maximum Aura. Making a pact generates 1 Weave.
Restriction.countHint: Maximum number of restrictions = maximum Aura.

Rite.motor: Motor Rite (+1 action, +1 damage per Hit)
Rite.motorHint: Movements, dances, hand seals: +1 damage per Hit (or +1 to PD damage). Costs +1 action.
Rite.sonicHint: Incantations and shouts: reduce the Aura cost by 1 (minimum 1). Requires having channeled the previous turn.
Rite.weaveNote: Each rite performed generates 1 Weave Point.

Attack.payPrice: No Hits on the FIERCE attack: pay a price.
Attack.safoResult: SAVVY contest: the winner chooses a price for the loser to pay.

Defense.dodgeResult: Dodge: if {hits} Hits beat the attacker's Hits, you take no damage.
Defense.guardRaisedBonus: Guard raised: +1d on this defense test.

Action.title: Actions
Action.notice: Notice (SWIFT): describe something you just noticed or ask the Weaver a question based on your senses. +1 die in the Common Pool.
Action.recall: Recall (SAVVY): describe a relevant memory or secret, or ask the Weaver about knowledge and stories. +1 die in the Common Pool.
Action.channelHint: Recover 1 Aura and start channeling until the beginning of your next turn.
Action.raiseGuardHint: +1d on defense tests until you use an action. Shift+click: spend 1 FIERCE to recover all your Guard.

Damage.pierceHint: PD damage ignores barriers and defense tests.
Damage.dialogHint: Applied to the selected targets (T). Adjust the value after defenses (block etc.).

Test.title: Test
Test.rollHint: Click to test. Shift+click rolls without asking.
Test.bonusHint: Add +1 per advantage and −1 per disadvantage.
Test.configHint: Optional. When set, using the ability rolls the test and computes damage.

Pool.label: Common Pool
Pool.hint: Extra dice for the scene (+Δd). Using them makes the Weaver roll the Echo Die; on a complication, the pool loses a die.
Pool.removed: Complication: one die leaves the Common Pool.

Weave.label: Weave
Weave.hint: The Weaver's Weave Points: generated by 1s on rolls, rites and pacts; spent on complications and Threat powers.
Weave.endSceneHint: Protagonists recover 1 in each reserve, clear their temporary wound, reset Guard to maximum and recover half their Memory. The Weaver gains 1 Weave.
Weave.endSceneSummary: {count} protagonist(s) recovered reserves and Guard. +1 Weave.
Weave.startSessionHint: Resets the Weave and gives 1 point per connected player.
Weave.startSessionSummary: The Weave starts the session at {weave}.

EchoDie.title: Echo Die
EchoDie.speaker: Echo Die
EchoDie.hint: 1d8: complication on a 1 or a result lower than the current Weave. Shift+click to add spent Hits.
EchoDie.complication: Complication! Something doesn't go as planned.

Rest.title: Rest
Rest.confirm: Resting restores reserves, Guard and Memory and clears Temporary and Serious wounds. A Mortal Wound requires medical care or supernatural healing. Continue?
Rest.done: {name} rests: reserves, Guard and Memory restored.
Rest.mortalWarning: An untreated Mortal Wound during the rest means death!

Threat.title: Threat
Threat.testDangerHint: Rolls DANGER d6; 1, 5 and 6 are Hits.
Threat.applyTableHint: Sets Guard, Danger and Defense from the improvisation table (Minion: Guard 1, Defense 0).
Threat.attackHitsHint: Attacks count as {hits} Hits (GRADE + current DANGER) for the protagonists' defense.

basicAttackText.ligeiro: Damage equal to GRADE + DANGER. Deals +1 PD damage if the target got one Hit or fewer when defending.
basicAttackText.safo: SAVVY contest: the winner chooses a price for the loser to pay.

Threat.exposedNow: {name} spends {defense} DEFENSE, recovers {guard} Guard and becomes exposed.

Item.d66Hint: Position on the random table (d66 / d6).

onesGrantAura.name: 1s grant Aura
onesGrantAura.hint: Per REDUX: each 1 left on a roll gives the Weaver Weave and the Protagonist Aura. Turn off to only generate Weave.

backgroundBonusDice.name: Background/Inventory dice
backgroundBonusDice.hint: How many dice Background/Inventory grants when generating 1 Weave (the official sheet says +1d; the sample sheet, +2d).

playersAdjustPool.name: Players adjust the Common Pool
playersAdjustPool.hint: Lets players add dice to the Common Pool (Create Advantage).

showWeavePanel.name: Show Weave panel
showWeavePanel.hint: Displays the panel with Weave, Common Pool and Echo Die.

Notify.noGM: No Weaver (GM) connected to record the change.
Notify.poolGMOnly: Only the Weaver can add dice to the Common Pool.
Notify.noTargets: Select one or more targets (T key) before applying damage.
Notify.abilitiesLimit: More abilities than Memory ({max}). Check with the Weaver.
